candidate.name: intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p
candidate.mechanism: unsigned endpoint displacement divided by total absolute path variation of log1p amount, pooled across two separately reset 120-bar half sessions
candidate.formula: x_i=log1p(amount_i); for each half h, E_h=abs(x_last-x_first) and V_h=sum(abs(diff(x))) over 119 within-half transitions; score=(E_morning+E_afternoon)/(V_morning+V_afternoon)

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Reverse minute order separately inside each 120-bar half while preserving every amount value and half membership.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign081_result: unchanged because both the absolute endpoint displacement and total absolute variation are reversal invariant
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount center of mass, clock dispersion, peak recency, late-window share, and terminal-bar share

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Permute fixed interior log-amount values within a half while preserving its first value, last value, and complete amount multiset.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign081_result: generally changes through total variation while the endpoint numerator and permutation-invariant amount entropy remain fixed
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount entropy, concentration, totals, and any multiset-only statistic

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Replace a monotone path between fixed endpoints by a zigzag path using interior values within the same endpoint range.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign081_result: decreases whenever the added reversals increase total variation; a nonconstant monotone half has efficiency one
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: endpoint-only amount change and range-only summaries

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Construct two paths with the same endpoints and total variation but different numbers of strict adjacent local maxima.
Change the last morning and first afternoon log amounts while holding all within-half transitions fixed by translating each complete half independently.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign081_result: unchanged and no 11:30-to-13:01 transition is introduced
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: an artificial cross-lunch path and absolute amount-level summaries

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every nominal amount by a common positive constant.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign081_result: not asserted invariant because log1p(c*a) is not an additive shift of log1p(a); this sensitivity is frozen and cannot be retroactively normalized away
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: rank-only or common-scale-invariant amount topology while preventing a false invariance claim

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold all 240 amount values fixed while changing minute and daily OHLC, returns, ranges, transaction prices, financial statements, issuer events, turnover fields, and market-peer paths.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: all price-path, return-state, transaction-price, turnover, event, fundamental, market-coupling, and Candidate49 mechanisms

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the closest frozen functional family because both divide endpoint displacement by accumulated absolute path movement
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor is signed and uses the one-session close-price path; Campaign081 is directionless, uses only log1p amount, pools two unsigned half-session ratios through their raw numerator and denominator components, and resets at lunch. The input economics are price discovery versus participation-schedule coherence, but numeric redundancy remains a mandatory empirical question.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: afternoon_signed_amount_efficiency_120m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both involve intraday amount and an efficiency ratio
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor is the signed sum of amount-weighted afternoon close returns divided by weighted absolute returns and includes the 11:30-to-13:01 price move; Campaign081 uses amount as the path itself, has no price or signed return, treats both halves symmetrically, and excludes lunch adjacency.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_diffusive_variation_ratio_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both contrast a path-scale movement with accumulated variation
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor uses close returns and a diffusive price-variation construction; Campaign081 uses unsigned log-amount endpoint displacement over L1 variation, separately reset at lunch.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_profile_serial_persistence_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use ordering of the one-session amount path
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: serial persistence is a linear adjacent-level association; Campaign081 is a nonlinear endpoint-to-total-variation geometry that is reversal invariant and can be one for every nonconstant monotone path regardless of slope.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: local peak density counts strict adjacent maxima; Campaign081 measures the aggregate excess travel beyond endpoints. Paths can share peak count but differ in travel magnitude, or share endpoints and total variation while differing in peak count.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_above_median_amount_longest_run_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both summarize within-half persistence of the amount path and reset at lunch
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign080 is an ordinal binary threshold-duration statistic invariant to monotone transforms; Campaign081 is a continuous log-amount geometry using every transition magnitude and no median threshold.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both summarize one stock-day's exact amount bars
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: entropy depends on normalized amount mass but ignores order; Campaign081 changes under interior permutations and focuses on path travel relative to endpoints.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m, intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m, late_amount_share_30m, and intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all can react to a migrating activity schedule

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b, intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b, and intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors compare against another half, day, or market profile; Campaign081 uses one stock-day path and no reference profile, lag, or peer.
